name: PeakCSR
description: PCSR 1v1 Live Ranked extension for PEAK RANKED. Real-time same-seed 1v1 matchmaking, Sudden Death rulesets, progress-weighted ELO with tier subdivisions, 30s post-finish timeout, live queue telemetry, in-match map reroll/forfeit voting, and a dedicated post-match report with split comparison and animated ELO.
